_comment: Model catalogue for this stack. 'repo' + 'repoFile' is what llm-fetch.ps1 downloads; 'file' is the name it must have in models\ for the registry, presets and launcher to find it. 'localSha256' is the sha256 of the exact file benchmarked on this machine (record only - uploaders can re-upload the same quant with different bytes). 'verified' means the local file is byte-identical to what this source serves.

models.note: Byte-identical to the file benchmarked here. Fastest model - 74 t/s at 131k context, native tool calls.
Byte-identical. 30 t/s at 49k context. NVFP4 has no fast CPU vector path, so the expert layers stay on the GPU.

Strongest model - 34 t/s at 20.5k context, native tool calls. The local copy (21.72 GB) came from another uploader; this is the closest published size, ~0.3 GB smaller, so it will fit at the same -n-cpu-moe 30.
Canonical MXFP4 build by the llama.cpp team. About 1.7 GB smaller than the local copy, so 24576 context fits comfortably. No native tool calls - cannot drive an agent loop.
Official Qwen release, same filename. Thinks before answering; 59 t/s at 16k context (its ceiling on this card).
Official Qwen release; same byte size as the local copy. 50 t/s at its full 32768 context, but NO native tool calls.
